name: Apache Kvrocks Open Source
free_limit: Apache-2.0 Redis-protocol-compatible, RocksDB-backed distributed key-value database with replication, namespaces and cluster support; self-hosted software has no license fee or vendor usage quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted Apache-2.0 Redis-protocol-compatible database, not a vendor-hosted Redis free plan. Operators provide servers, persistent storage, backups, replication/failover configuration, security and monitoring; cloud compute, disks and network can incur charges. Redis clients and other third-party components have separate licensing/usage terms.
